scope: SVG inline font-size admission retains its source context; text layout and all previous reference bytes/tolerances remain unchanged. Supplied-program original contexts remain individually scoped and open.
sharedRule: Positive unitless font sizes are accepted in SVG style attributes. Rule blocks keep CSS nonzero-unit requirements; importance, inheritance and later-rule admission remain shared. A named stylesheet entry point uses the existing target domain and parser/string owners.

failingBefore.reason: Six actual-value failures; importance, negative-size and stylesheet companions pass. No missing-method/type/discovery failures.

mechanisms.correctedAssertions: Existing inline, inherited, span, retained paint-scan and direct synthetic-text assertions had assumed unitless inline sizes were ignored. They now protect the independently observed source distinction; stylesheet regressions remain unchanged.

contract.role: Prepared inherited inline size survives a later invalid unitless rule, matches the explicit presentation-attribute control and acquires one program once. No fixture/API product.

programTransport.scope: Disposable exact geometry/advance transport for native and library font-context research; no source SVG retained, no original font acceptance. No hint programs or kerning are invented. SVG font-face descriptors here omit weight/style and have no kern elements.

rejectedClosestPrograms.reason: Advance agreement did not establish identical outlines. Rounded embedded SVG coordinates differ from the pinned Android TrueType programs; no coordinate tolerance or image fitting was used.

nativeProgramControl.scope: Own square glyph distinguishes supplied TrueType use from absent-font fallback on both hosts; inline/rule and doctype variants isolate the size source. One fresh healthy/profile-cleaned capture per exploratory case; canonical admission is separately triple-captured.
